audience: Mexican businesses and accountants who issue CFDI 4.0 invoices with Facturama

useCases.title: Find invoices issued this month
useCases.text: List issued CFDIs ten at a time, filtered by status, folio range, issue date, receiver name, series or payment method. Only documents issued through the API appear.

useCases.title: Download an invoice as PDF or XML
useCases.text: Download the XML or PDF file of one CFDI. The XML comes back as text. The PDF comes back as base64 content.

useCases.title: Find SAT codes for a product
useCases.text: Search the SAT product and unit catalogs by keyword, for example software or service. Use the codes on a new product.

useCases.title: Review the client and product catalogs
useCases.text: List clients and products, a page at a time, with a search text. Open one to see its fiscal data, address or price.

useCases.title: Add a client or product to the catalog
useCases.text: Search the client list first to avoid a duplicate RFC, then create the client or product. Neither one issues an invoice.
